senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; cmp. מִי, מַאן)kind, genus, species.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:5">Peah II, 5</cite> <he>מ׳ אחד</he> one kind of seed.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 2:4">Ter. II, 4</cite> <he>אין תורמין ממ׳ על שאינו מִינוֹ</he> you must not separate T’rumah from one species to redeem fruits of another species.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 2:6">Ib. 6</cite>. <he>הקישות … מ׳ אחד</he> cucumbers and melopepons are considered as the same species.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 3:10">Bicc. III, 10</cite> <he>תוספת הבכורים מ׳ במינו</he> what you add to the legally required quantity of first fruits must be of the same species; what is used for decorating the first fruits, <he>מ׳ בשאינו מינו</he> must be of a different kind.—
<cite ref="Chullin 100a:8">Ḥull. 100ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מין במינו לא בטיל</he>, v. <cite ref="B00516"><he>בְּטֵל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 97b:2">Ib. 97ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ בשאינו מינו</he> a heterogeneous mixture (of forbidden, and permitted things); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>מִינִים</he>, <he>מִינִין</he>, constr. <he>מִינֵי</he>. Peah l. c. <he>זרעה שני מ׳</he> if he planted on it two different seeds. Ib. <he>שני מיני חטים</he> two kinds of wheat.

<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 6:1">Naz. VI, 1</cite> <he>שלשה מ׳ אסורין וכ׳</he> three kinds of prohibitions exist with reference to the nazarite.—<he>שבעת המ׳</he> the seven products of Palestine (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 8:8">Deut. VIII, 8</cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 1:3">Bicc. I, 3</cite>; a. fr.—<he>חמשת המ׳</he> the five species of grain (wheat, barley, rye, oat and spelt).
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 7:2">Ned. VII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—<he>ארבעה מ׳</he> (<he>שבלולב</he>) the four species of the festive wreath, v. <cite ref="L00270"><he>לוּלָב</he></cite>.
Men. III, 6; a. fr.—כְּמִין something like, in the shape of, of the nature of.
<cite ref="Keritot 5b:114">Ker. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>כמ׳ נזר</he> drawing the shape of a crown; <he>כמ׳ כי יוני</he>, v. <cite ref="K00473"><he>כי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 5b:114">Ib.</cite> <he>כמ׳ שתי טיפין וכ׳</he> two drops of oil looking like pearls.
